comment: Motion tokens — mirrors the --primitive-duration-*, --primitive-easing-*, and --motion-* variables in globals.css. Primitives hold raw values; semantic tokens name the intent and resolve to their CSS variable.

scale.comment: No CSS var — used inline as a transform value, not composable into a transition shorthand

opacity.comment: No CSS var — applied inline to the element style, not composable into a transition shorthand

pill-bg.comment: Pill fill cross-fades between on/off colors

primary.resolves: opacity var(--primitive-duration-fast) var(--primitive-easing-default), transform var(--primitive-duration-fast) var(--primitive-easing-default)
primary.comment: Primary button scales up and dims slightly on hover

secondary.resolves: color var(--primitive-duration-fast) var(--primitive-easing-default), opacity var(--primitive-duration-fast) var(--primitive-easing-default), transform var(--primitive-duration-fast) var(--primitive-easing-default)
secondary.comment: Secondary button shifts text color, scales, and dims on hover

trigger-border.resolves: border-color var(--primitive-duration-fast) var(--primitive-easing-default), box-shadow var(--primitive-duration-fast) var(--primitive-easing-default)
trigger-border.comment: Trigger field border and focus-ring on focus/open

chevron-rotate.comment: Chevron icon rotates 180° when menu opens

item-hover.comment: List item background snaps on cursor enter/leave — faster than other interactions to feel responsive

zoom-in.comment: Image zooms in on card hover. GSAP reads duration as a unitless seconds value (0.35); easing resolves to its cubic-bezier equivalent

zoom-out.comment: Image eases back with a symmetric in-out on mouse-leave. GSAP reads duration as a unitless seconds value (0.35)

focus.resolves: border-color var(--primitive-duration-fast) var(--primitive-easing-default), box-shadow var(--primitive-duration-fast) var(--primitive-easing-default)
focus.comment: Canonical focus transition for all form field inputs — replaces the duplicated raw 150ms ease strings across components

color.comment: Color-only transition for nav links, breadcrumbs, and other text-color hover states

state-values.comment: JS-readable scalar motion values. Also exposed in src/lib/motion-constants.ts for GSAP and JS consumers that cannot read CSS custom properties at runtime.

opacity-hover.comment: Matches primitive.opacity.hover — hover opacity for interactive elements

scale-hover.comment: Matches primitive.scale.hover — hover scale for GSAP transforms

scale-rest.comment: Resting scale — explicit return value for GSAP mouse-leave handlers

dismiss-ms.comment: Auto-dismiss delay in milliseconds. Use MOTION.duration.toast in JS; unit-free so it can be read directly via getComputedStyle if needed.
